description: ScribeKeys controls the audio or video playing in a Chrome tab while you type somewhere else. Write your transcript in Word, Google Docs or any other window, and pause, rewind or copy a timestamp without switching windows.
• Play / pause with automatic rewind: pausing jumps back 2 seconds (0–5, configurable), so you resume with context.
• Rewind and fast-forward by 3 seconds (1–60, configurable).
• Playback speed from 0.5× to 2× in 0.1× steps, and back to 1×.
• Copy the current time as a timestamp, such as [00:12:34] or 12:34.
• A brief on-page indicator confirms each action. You can turn it off.
• Works with HTML5 audio and video on any site you enable, including players inside iframes and media added after the page loads.
Suggested: Ctrl+Shift+1 play/pause · Ctrl+Shift+2 rewind · Ctrl+Shift+3 forward · Ctrl+Shift+4 copy timestamp.
At chrome://extensions/shortcuts, set their scope to “Global” so they work while Chrome is in the background. You can also assign the speed shortcuts there, or change any of them.
The tab you pin from the popup. If none is pinned, the last tab that played media. If that is gone, a tab that is playing sound.
• No site access at install. You enable each site from the popup and can remove it at any time.
• No network requests, no analytics, no ads. Nothing leaves your computer.
Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French and German.
Global shortcuts are not available on ChromeOS.

transcript: [00:00:04] Interviewer: Thanks for coming. Could you start by telling us how the project began?
[00:00:11] Guest: Of course. It started as a small community workshop, three or four people around a table.
[00:00:19] Interviewer: And when did it become something bigger?
[00:00:24] Guest: About two years later, when the library offered us a room every Saturday.
